title: The First Dream
journal: Vosh-Leera has a second task for me. I'm to ask her for it in her house in Jal-Veesa.
objectives: Ask Vosh-Leera for her second task. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka through Vosh-Leera; the trees are sick and nobody knows why.
plan.next: Ask Vosh-Leera, in her house, for the second task.

answers: I am a hunter freed from the Owing at Ashgate Landing by Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa. She secretly serves the Toh-Reel-Ka, Secret Warriors of the Xeech-Leel, who try to prevent another Umbriel-type disaster and use friendless strangers as spies. Jal-Veesa Hist is dying and trees along the river are sickening; nobody knows why.
Go to Vosh-Leera (marker) at her House in Jal-Veesa and ask for her second task.
I can accept the task she gives, or ask questions first; I have 50 gold and two lockpicks. I mean to pursue the truth. I do not yet know what the task is.
I do not understand why the trees are sick, what the second task is, or the full nature of the Toh-Reel-Ka. I could ask Vosh-Leera, and Weeltul about the sap, scar and Umbriel.

title: The First Dream
journal: Vosh-Leera gave me a cup of Jal-Veesa's sap, drawn before its scar closed. Tree-minders drink sap to ask the trees a question, and she wants me to ask where the sickness is. I'm to drink it here, in front of her.
objectives: Drink the cup of sap in front of Vosh-Leera. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: Sap drunk brings visions the trees send; Vosh-Leera wants me to ask the trees where the sickness is.
plan.next: Drink the cup in front of her, by telling her I will.

answers: Vosh-Leera gave me a cup of Hist sap drawn before the scar closed. The trees are joined at the root, so drinking it lets me ask where the sickness is and see what the trees show.
Drink the cup in front of Vosh-Leera, here in Jal-Veesa, then tell her everything I see.
I can drink it now as asked, or first talk to her/Weeltul about the risks; I mean to report truthfully what I see.
I do not know what drinking the sap will do to me or whether it is safe. I could ask Vosh-Leera or Weeltul.

title: The First Dream
journal: I drank the sap and the world went black. I saw a young Hist among stilt huts beside a woven weir, and a reed hide beside a lone dead tree. I'm to tell Vosh-Leera what I saw.
objectives: Tell Vosh-Leera what you saw. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: The sap showed me a young Hist by a woven weir among stilt huts, and a reed hide by a lone dead tree.
plan.next: Tell Vosh-Leera what I saw, one thing at a time.

answers: I drank the sap and saw a vision: a young Hist among stilt huts beside a woven weir, and a reed hide beside a lone dead tree. This is where the trees show the sickness is.
Tell Vosh-Leera what I saw, here in Jal-Veesa.
I can tell her everything truthfully (my aim), or hold back; I mean to tell the truth.
I do not know which place the weir and stilt huts are (perhaps Reed-Sill Weir?), who or what the reed hide and dead tree belong to, or what causes the sickness. Vosh-Leera or Weeltul may know.

title: The First Dream
journal: Vosh-Leera knew the place from what I told her. It is Teel-Fen Weir, a weir-wardens' camp south of Jal-Veesa, where a young Hist grew from the roots of Jal-Veesa's own. Heem-Jasa minds its tree there. I'm to go to Teel-Fen Weir and speak to Heem-Jasa.
objectives: Speak to Heem-Jasa at Teel-Fen Weir. (marker: Heem-Jasa)

plan.going: The vision showed Teel-Fen Weir, whose young Hist grew from Jal-Veesa's roots.
plan.next: Go south to Teel-Fen Weir and speak to Heem-Jasa, its tree-minder.

answers: The vision showed Teel-Fen Weir, a Sedge-Wardens camp south of Jal-Veesa down the creek, where a young Hist grew from Jal-Veesa tree roots. A reed hide with jars of sap sits west of the weir by a lone dead tree; someone may be keeping sap. Vosh-Leera told me to be careful at the hide.
Go to Teel-Fen Weir and speak to Heem-Jasa, the tree-minder, on the platform round the tree.
I can go straight to Heem-Jasa and ask what she knows, or look at the hide; Vosh-Leera advised seeing Heem-Jasa first. I mean to find the truth.
I do not know who is keeping the jars, why the lone tree is dead, or what causes the sickness. Heem-Jasa may know.

title: The First Dream
journal: Heem-Jasa showed me her young tree's scar. It closed three nights ago over a grey paste that none of her people put there. Someone drained the tree and sealed it. Strangers keep jars at the reed hide by the lone dead tree west of the weir, the hide from my vision. I'm to take what they have. I can fight them, shoot them from the reeds, or creep in to the jars unseen.
objectives: Take the note from the reed hide west of Teel-Fen Weir. (marker: Note to the Sap-Takers)

plan.going: The young tree was drained and sealed with a grey paste by people, not by sickness. The strangers at the hide keep jars of sap.
plan.next: Go to the reed hide west of the weir and take the note lying with the jars; take a jar too.
plan.ways: Fight the three, shoot them from the reeds, or sneak to the west side of the hide and take the note unseen.

answers: Heem-Jasa says her young tree was drained and its scar sealed with grey paste three nights ago, not by her people. Three strangers (Unbound Sap-Takers) keep jars at the reed hide west of the weir; they seem to be draining Hist trees, which may explain the sickness.
Take the Note to the Sap-Takers from the reed hide west of Teel-Fen Weir.
I can fight the three, shoot them from the reeds east of the hide, or creep to the hide open west side unseen to take the note and jars. I mean to find the truth, so the note matters most.
I do not know who the Unbound Sap-Takers work for, what the grey paste is, or why they take sap. The note may tell me.

title: The First Dream
journal: I took the note from the reed hide. The crew's master orders them to bring their jars to Karsh-Naal Camp, and to seal every scar behind them. I'm to go back to Heem-Jasa on the platform. She will ask whether her tree will live; she teaches and trades only with those who are straight with her.
objectives: Return to Heem-Jasa at Teel-Fen Weir. (marker: Heem-Jasa)

plan.going: The sap-takers drain trees and seal them on someone's orders, and carry the jars to Karsh-Naal Camp.
plan.next: Go back to Heem-Jasa, who will ask whether her tree will live.
plan.ways: Tell her the truth (it may die: she then trains me in Alchemy and sells to me) or a comfort (it will live: she gives me three potions of Cure Poison now, but will not train or trade with me).

answers: I took the note without a fight. It shows the Sap-Takers crew is ordered by their master to bring jars of sap to Karsh-Naal Camp and seal every scar behind them. So someone organized is draining Hist trees, which likely causes the sickness.
Return to Heem-Jasa at Teel-Fen Weir and be straight with her; she will ask whether her tree will live.
I can tell her the truth, including what the note says, or soften it; I mean to tell the truth. Later I can go to Karsh-Naal Camp.
I do not know who the master is, where Karsh-Naal Camp is, or why they want the sap. I could ask Heem-Jasa and Vosh-Leera.

title: The First Dream
journal: I told Heem-Jasa the truth, that her tree may die. She thanked me for not lying, and offered to teach me alchemy and sell me what she has. The note names Karsh-Naal Camp.

plan.going: I told Heem-Jasa the truth, that her tree may die. She thanked me for not lying, and offered to teach me alchemy and sell me what she has. The note names Karsh-Naal Camp.

answers: The sickness comes from someone draining Hist trees of sap and sealing the scars with grey paste. The Sap-Takers crew sends jars to Karsh-Naal Camp. I told Heem-Jasa the truth and she will teach and sell to me.
The quest is complete; the next lead is Karsh-Naal Camp, and reporting to Vosh-Leera.
I can go to Karsh-Naal Camp, report to Vosh-Leera, or learn alchemy from Heem-Jasa.
I do not know where Karsh-Naal Camp is, who the master is, or why they want the sap. Heem-Jasa has a topic on the camp.
